instruction: Enable automatic formatting of code when saving files in VS Code.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling format on save feature. Evaluator checks if settings.json contains 'editor.formatOnSave': true.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves VS Code settings file from the standard location (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Metric correctly parses JSON and checks for the exact setting required (editor.formatOnSave: true)
Expected value is semantically correct - 'editor.formatOnSave': true is the correct VS Code setting for enabling format-on-save
Complete coverage - the evaluator checks the only requirement in the instruction
No state timing issues - settings.json is persistent and doesn't require UI to be open
Robust error handling - handles missing file, invalid JSON, missing keys, and wrong values
Data flow is correct - file path -> JSON parsing -> key-value verification
